verdict.rationale: AIMA's public site could plausibly publish an llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so this question applies to the product. However, the evidence pack contains no sign of either. The only probe failed TLS verification at robots.txt, and nothing on the host was fetched, so no llms.txt or agent docs were observed.
